**Issue 1 – Wrong event (Canvas.tsx line 88)**
The PR description says "Uses `FORCE_REMOUNT` event, matching the existing Story canvas reload behavior." The code emits `RESET_STORY_ARGS`. From the codebase: `FORCE_REMOUNT` = "force the current story to re-render from scratch" (full unmount/remount); `RESET_STORY_ARGS` = "reset either a single arg or all args of a story" (re-renders with initial args but the component stays mounted, preserving internal component state from `useState`, class lifecycle, etc.). These are meaningfully different for stories with internal side effects. This is a semantic deviation.

**Issue 2 – Default is `false`, contradicts PR description (Canvas.tsx line 85)**
PR description: "shown by default for all inline stories — no configuration needed." Code: `resetButton ?? false`. The button is **off by default** and requires explicit opt-in via `parameters.docs.canvas.resetButton = true`. This contradicts the stated behavior.

**Issue 3 – Name/icon inconsistency between PR title and implementation (Preview.tsx line 267)**
PR title: "Reload story." Button text: "Reset story." Icon: `UndoIcon`. The existing toolbar uses "Reload story" + `SyncIcon` for `FORCE_REMOUNT`. The two patterns imply different semantics, and the naming is unsettled across the PR.

**Issue 4 – `ariaLabel={false}` on icon+text button**
This is consistent with other buttons in the same action bar (lines 255, etc.) where the visible text label provides the accessible name. Not an issue.

**Issue 5 – `additionalActions` pattern inconsistency**
Looking at the existing `additionalActions` buttons (line 270-278), they don't have a fixed position relative to the source buttons — the reset button is hardcoded between the source buttons and `additionalActions`. This is a minor design choice but fine.
